title: A computational insight of the physical properties of MoSX (X= Cl, Br, I) for green energy applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,47282-47290
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07274C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Muhammad Yousuf, Ali Raza, Farooq Ali, Hamid Ullah, Young-Han Shin, Essam A. Al-Ammar
A First-principles calculations reveals the energetical stable nature of MoSX (X = Cl, Br, I) due to lower formation energies. They possesses a bandgaps ranging from 1.24 eV to 1.38 eV. Notably, MoSCl and MoSBr shows a direct bandgap.
